name: Pallbearer Giant
summary: A risen giant that still carries its own coffin-sized burden.
description: Pallbearer giants walk the ridgelines in funeral procession, hauling a corpse in their arms for a burial that never arrives. The thing they carry is the only gentle part of them.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: If damage reduces the giant to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a {dc=5} plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success, the giant drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Funeral Tread
traits.text: Creatures within 10 feet of the giant that are Large or smaller have their Speed halved.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two Slam attacks, or one Slam attack and one Hurl Corpse.

actions.name: Hurl Corpse
actions.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
